# Generated by the ZIN content builder (modules/mech_elves.mjs, mech_lerendor.mjs, mech_volgan.mjs; docs/design/stage2/mech_powers.md). Do not edit by hand.
# Run by the hidden event zin_dominion.1 the day after the start: start values, the dynamic modifier, the start spirits of both trees, Mirolon's forts at level 2 and High Warden Maeric (section "Files").
zin_dominion_startup = {
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = PUV }
		PUV = {
			set_variable = { zin_dominion_strength = 45 }
			set_variable = { zin_volgan_veil = 85 }
			set_variable = { zin_nether_pact = 20 }
			set_variable = { zin_volgan_musters = 0 }
			set_variable = { zin_volgan_free_gates = 0 }
			set_variable = { zin_dominion_gate_cost = 50 }
			set_variable = { zin_volgan_envoy_cost = 25 }
			set_variable = { zin_volgan_muster_schedule = 50 }
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_dominion_hosts }
			zin_volgan_refresh_strength = yes
			add_ideas = zin_volgan_long_recovery
			add_ideas = zin_volgan_storm_girt_realm

			zin_dominion_ui_refresh_volgan = yes
		}
	}
	set_variable = { global.zin_volgan_veil_band = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = KHO }
		KHO = { set_variable = { zin_dominion_oath = 60 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = DLN }
		DLN = { set_variable = { zin_dominion_oath = 55 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = NEZ }
		NEZ = { set_variable = { zin_dominion_oath = 50 } }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_dominion_is_dark_lands_country = yes }
		set_variable = { zin_volgan_pact = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = MIR }
		MIR = {
			set_variable = { zin_mirolon_proof = 15 }
			set_variable = { zin_mirolon_passes = 30 }
			set_variable = { zin_mirolon_fort_level = 0 }
			set_variable = { zin_mirolon_war_days = 0 }
			add_ideas = zin_mirolon_long_watch
			add_ideas = zin_mirolon_unheeded_warnings
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_character = zin_mirolon_maeric } } zin_mirolon_maeric = { set_nationality = PREV } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_in_play_mirolon_maeric } } set_global_flag = zin_in_play_mirolon_maeric }
			add_country_leader_role = {
				character = zin_mirolon_maeric
				promote_leader = yes
				country_leader = { ideology = zin_light_wardens expire = "1965.1.1.1" traits = { zin_trait_elected_speaker } }
			}
			zin_mirolon_raise_pass_forts = yes
			zin_dominion_ui_refresh_mirolon = yes
		}
	}
}

# Scope: Volgan. Positions of the gauge markers of the Southern Dominion panel.
zin_dominion_ui_refresh_volgan = {
	set_variable = { zin_ui_hosts_x = zin_dominion_strength }
	multiply_variable = { zin_ui_hosts_x = 5.2 }
	add_to_variable = { zin_ui_hosts_x = 27 }
	set_variable = { zin_ui_veil_x = zin_volgan_veil }
	multiply_variable = { zin_ui_veil_x = 5.2 }
	add_to_variable = { zin_ui_veil_x = 27 }
	set_variable = { zin_ui_nether_x = zin_nether_pact }
	multiply_variable = { zin_ui_nether_x = 5.2 }
	add_to_variable = { zin_ui_nether_x = 27 }
	set_variable = { zin_ui_dark_1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { zin_ui_dark_2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { zin_ui_dark_3 = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_dominion_is_dark_lands_country = yes check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_pact value = 1 compare = equals } }
		PUV = { add_to_variable = { zin_ui_dark_1 = 1 } }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_dominion_is_dark_lands_country = yes check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_pact value = 2 compare = equals } }
		PUV = { add_to_variable = { zin_ui_dark_2 = 1 } }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_dominion_is_dark_lands_country = yes check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_pact value = 3 compare = equals } }
		PUV = { add_to_variable = { zin_ui_dark_3 = 1 } }
	}
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_ui_tick = 1 }
}

# Scope: Mirolon. Positions of the gauge markers of the Watch panel.
zin_dominion_ui_refresh_mirolon = {
	set_variable = { zin_ui_proof_x = zin_mirolon_proof }
	multiply_variable = { zin_ui_proof_x = 5.2 }
	add_to_variable = { zin_ui_proof_x = 27 }
	set_variable = { zin_ui_passes_x = zin_mirolon_passes }
	multiply_variable = { zin_ui_passes_x = 5.2 }
	add_to_variable = { zin_ui_passes_x = 27 }
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_ui_tick = 1 }
}

# Scope: Volgan. The Dominion pulse (sections 1 to 13): strength, the veil, the oaths, costs, the Abyss Host, Mirolon's fall, the clash and the compact, the sandbox rule, the layouts.
zin_dominion_monthly_volgan = {
	# strength: recovery, then the toll of war
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_volgan_body_destroyed } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_gain = 0.15 }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_members = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = KHO
				KHO = { check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_oath value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_members = 0.05 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = DLN
				DLN = { check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_oath value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_members = 0.05 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = NEZ
				NEZ = { check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_oath value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_members = 0.05 }
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = zin_volgan_t_members max = 0.15 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_gain = zin_volgan_t_members }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_volgan_dominion_tribute } add_to_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_gain = 0.05 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_nether_pact value = 40 compare = greater_than_or_equals } } add_to_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_gain = 0.1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_dark = 0 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_dominion_is_dark_lands_country = yes
				check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_pact value = 2 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			}
			add_to_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_dark = 0.05 }
		}
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = zin_volgan_t_dark max = 0.15 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_gain = zin_volgan_t_dark }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_volgan_t_gain }
		zin_volgan_add_dominion_strength = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_war = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -0.5 }
		zin_volgan_add_dominion_strength = yes
		if = {
			limit = { surrender_progress > 0.3 }
			set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -0.5 }
			zin_volgan_add_dominion_strength = yes
		}
	}
	# the veil mends while no muster is held and no war is fought
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_war = yes }
			check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_veil value = 85 compare = less_than }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_volgan_mustered }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_veil = 1.5 }
		if = { limit = { has_idea = zin_volgan_storm_rites } add_to_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_veil = 0.5 } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_volgan_t_veil }
		zin_volgan_add_veil = yes
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_veil value = 85 compare = greater_than } } set_variable = { zin_volgan_veil = 85 } }
	}
	# the oaths drift unless the Dominion was summoned in the last 180 days
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_dominion_summoned } }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_target = -1 }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -0.2 }
		zin_volgan_add_oath = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = KHO
			KHO = {
				check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_oath value = 25 compare = less_than }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_dominion_oath_warned }
			}
		}
		KHO = {
			set_country_flag = { flag = zin_dominion_oath_warned days = 365 }
			country_event = { id = zin_dominion.22 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = DLN
			DLN = {
				check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_oath value = 25 compare = less_than }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_dominion_oath_warned }
			}
		}
		DLN = {
			set_country_flag = { flag = zin_dominion_oath_warned days = 365 }
			country_event = { id = zin_dominion.22 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = NEZ
			NEZ = {
				check_variable = { var = zin_dominion_oath value = 25 compare = less_than }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_dominion_oath_warned }
			}
		}
		NEZ = {
			set_country_flag = { flag = zin_dominion_oath_warned days = 365 }
			country_event = { id = zin_dominion.22 }
		}
	}
	# the cost of the envoys, the Nether Gate and the muster schedule follow the trees' flags and the calendar
	set_variable = { zin_volgan_envoy_cost = 25 }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = zin_volgan_envoys_cheap } set_variable = { zin_volgan_envoy_cost = 15 } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = zin_volgan_free_gates
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_dominion_gates_granted }
		}
		set_country_flag = zin_dominion_gates_granted
		set_variable = { zin_volgan_free_gates = 2 }
	}
	set_variable = { zin_dominion_gate_cost = 50 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = zin_volgan_free_gates value = 0 compare = greater_than } } set_variable = { zin_dominion_gate_cost = 0 } }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_years = global.year }
	add_to_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_years = -1748 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { var = global.zin_story_pace value = 0 compare = greater_than } } divide_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_years = global.zin_story_pace } }
	multiply_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_years = 5 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_years = 50 }
	set_variable = { zin_volgan_muster_schedule = zin_volgan_t_years }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_dark_powers option = AGGRESSIVE }
		}
		add_to_variable = { zin_volgan_muster_schedule = 5 }
	}
	# the Abyss Host follows the march
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_flag = zin_volgan_marches
			has_country_flag = zin_volgan_abyss_march
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_volgan_abyss_host_spawned }
		}
		zin_volgan_spawn_abyss_host = yes
	}
	# Mirolon falls when it yields, or when its capital and its passes are in Volgan's hands
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = MIR
			has_war_with = MIR
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_mirolon_fallen }
			zin_volgan_mirolon_taken = yes
		}
		zin_dominion_mirolon_falls = yes
	}
	# the march catch-up (SL-34): under the historical branch an AI Volgan that has not taken its focus marches 30 days after Mirolon's fall
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			zin_rules_is_historical = yes
			has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_dark_powers option = HISTORICAL }
			has_global_flag = { flag = zin_mirolon_fallen days > 29 }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_volgan_marches }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_volgan_body_destroyed }
		}
		zin_volgan_begin_march = yes
	}
	# the dead against the dead
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_war_with = ZOL
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_volgan_zol_clash }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_volgan_zol_clash
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_dominion_clash_ready = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_dominion_clash_asked }
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_dominion_clash_asked days = 90 }
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { zin_rules_is_historical = yes }
				zin_volgan_strike_zol = yes
			}
			else = {
				random_list = {
					80 = { zin_volgan_strike_zol = yes }
					20 = { }
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			country_event = { id = zin_dominion.13 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_dominion_compact_active = yes
			has_global_flag = zin_kusven_withdrawn
		}
		zin_dominion_end_compact = yes
	}
	# a sandbox rule: the throne may stir, once a year, from 1 Thaw 4A 1765
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_game_rule = { rule = zin_rule_volgan_spirit option = STIRRING }
			has_global_flag = zin_volgan_body_destroyed
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_dominion_stirred }
			zin_dominion_after_1765_03 = yes
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_dominion_stir_rolled }
		}
		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_dominion_stir_rolled days = 365 }
		random = {
			chance = 10
			country_event = { id = zin_dominion.25 }
		}
	}
	# the Middle Lands states Volgan holds (Wake the Old Battlefields)
	set_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_mid = 0 }
	every_controlled_state = {
		limit = { zin_dominion_is_middle_lands_state = yes }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_volgan_t_mid = 1 }
	}
	set_variable = { zin_dominion_middle_held = zin_volgan_t_mid }
	zin_dominion_ui_refresh_volgan = yes
	# last, the trees refresh their layouts (decision E4)
	mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = MIR }
		MIR = { mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = KHO }
		KHO = { mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = DLN }
		DLN = { mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = NEZ }
		NEZ = { mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes }
	}
}

# Scope: Mirolon. The Watch pulse (section 8): the days the passes have held, Hold the Passes, the layout.
zin_dominion_monthly_mirolon = {
	# days at war without losing a pass
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = PUV
			has_war_with = PUV
			NOT = {
				any_state = {
					zin_is_site_mirolon_passes = yes
					controller = { original_tag = PUV }
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { zin_mirolon_war_days = 30 }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { zin_mirolon_war_days = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { var = zin_mirolon_war_days value = 365 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_mirolon_holds }
		}
		set_country_flag = zin_mirolon_holds
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = PUV }
			PUV = {
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -15 }
				zin_volgan_add_dominion_strength = yes
				add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_dominion_march_stalls days = 365 }
				country_event = { id = zin_dominion.20 }
			}
		}
		country_event = { id = zin_dominion.20 }
	}
	# Hold the Passes: forts ready, proof earned, and no pass state lost
	if = {
		limit = {
			country_exists = PUV
			has_war_with = PUV
			check_variable = { var = zin_mirolon_passes value = 80 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = zin_mirolon_proof value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			zin_mirolon_passes_held = yes
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = zin_dominion_hold_the_passes } } add_ideas = zin_dominion_hold_the_passes }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_idea = zin_dominion_hold_the_passes }
		remove_ideas = zin_dominion_hold_the_passes
	}
	zin_dominion_ui_refresh_mirolon = yes
	mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
}

# Scope: a state. A pass state or Nafeher changed hands (sections 1 and 8).
zin_dominion_state_changed = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_is_site_nafeher = yes
			NOT = { controller = { original_tag = PUV } }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_dominion_nafeher_lost }
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_dominion_nafeher_lost
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -20 }
		zin_volgan_add_dominion_strength = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { zin_is_site_mirolon_passes = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = MIR }
			MIR = {
				if = {
					limit = { has_idea = zin_dominion_hold_the_passes }
					remove_ideas = zin_dominion_hold_the_passes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
